name: PastEventsMore - The Link Out To Luma
description: The outlined pill button under the recent past-event cards, View all past events on Luma, centred and with no arrow per the site's button system. It exists because the page deliberately shows only the most recent few as cards, and this is the way to the rest for a reader who wants more. It used to be an underlined text link that did not read as a button.
